outer_variables: q20 plus proper phone SE3, fixed source wrist, no reflection or scaling

stage_A.purpose: Recover geometry using fixed material-point/anchor terms and gravity-line moment; not actual-contact qualification
stage_A.limits: Fixed material points are a smooth proposal model only. The98degree fixed-hand rotation was a collision failure and is not reused as a valid seed.

stage_B.purpose: 26D pose optimization with the physical inner-LP residual value, not a fit to chosen witness coordinates
stage_B.current_geometry_each_evaluation: All22 original phone-active proxies and189 eligible self pairs; fixed source bounds/wrist/scale. Intersection or unknown is rejected, not assigned zero cost.
stage_B.contact_position: Current genuine paired object/hand closest witnesses; solve barycentric support-feature correspondence and retain full3 residual/rank. Unique pair required for this point route; arbitrary support centroids forbidden.
stage_B.finite_patch_route: Only if actual paired surface region is established with nonzero area and all point pairs truly supported; current support-edge/vertex sets alone do not prove a patch. No invented torsion.
stage_B.force_model: lambda16 nonnegative inscribed8; mu_design=0.7/sqrt(2), actual sliding mu0.7; sum(lambda_per_pad)<=3N
stage_B.inner_objective: Minimum max absolute COM contact-moment component, Nm
stage_B.primary_force_infeasible: Keep primary false/None. Run at most one separate force-infinity recoveryLP with same hard torque/cap constraints and unconstrained moment; return finite guidance only. If torque-feasible cone absent, explicitly NO_TORQUE_FEASIBLE_CONE.
stage_B.smoothness: Piecewise smooth support value; actual convex feature/rank transitions remain explicit. Fixed worldY tangent reference is projected onto the current normal plane; chart pole is UNKNOWN, no implicit axis switching.

final_reporting: Recompute current mesh closest pairs, geometry and all hard bounds at the selected pose
Report exact zero-moment LP separately; unchanged old exact-LP core has no3N normal cap, so its force-budget compatibility must be reported separately
Report residual proposal gate independently from exact statics and actual finite-mesh holding
No small residual implies a2second5degree guarantee; no old failed trial is relabeled
No CI, trajectory generalization, real friction/inertia calibration, arbitrary torsion or remote-contact force claim
